description: This file defines the API routes for a subtitle synchronization backend service using FastAPI. It includes endpoint handlers for syncing subtitles with video files and retrieving download info about sync results. It interacts with processing functions which handle creating work directories, saving uploaded files, and performing subtitle processing.

classes.name: SyncResponse
classes.description: Model representing the response containing the path and details of the synchronized subtitle.

classes.name: SyncJobResult
classes.description: Model representing the result of a subtitle sync job, including an ID and the sync details.

classes.name: DownloadResponse
classes.description: Model representing information for downloading a synced subtitle, including path and existence status.

methods.name: SyncJobResult sync_subtitles( video: UploadFile = File(..., description="Video file containing the audio."), subtitle: UploadFile = File(..., description="Subtitle file (.srt, .vtt, .ass, .ssa)."), prefer_whisper: bool = Form(False, description="Use Whisper if available, otherwise stub."), whisper_model: str = Form("base", description="Whisper model name if prefer_whisper is true."), )
methods.description: API endpoint to upload a video and subtitle files, process them, and return the sync details and job ID.

methods.name: DownloadResponse get_download_info(job_id: str)
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve the file path and existence status of a synced subtitle based on a job ID.
